semantics.exact_statement: In a homogeneous coordinate chart adapted to a hypersurface-normal congruence, n_mu=(-N(t),0,0,0), the projected spatial antisymmetric derivative D_[i n_j] is identically zero. Hence omega_i=0 and W2=3 sum_i (omega_i/Theta)^2=0 for Theta=3H with H>0. The registered lower endpoint and interior challenge instead require W2=1/25 and W2=3/100, respectively, so neither can be a same-frame Bianchi-I hypersurface-normal constraint witness. A refuted constraint premise cannot promote to local- or global-dynamical sharpness.

symbol_type_domain_map.omega_i: spatial dual of the projected vorticity two-form
symbol_type_domain_map.Theta: real expansion scalar with Theta=3H and H>0

assumptions: the lower endpoint uses the Bianchi-I homogeneous solution class registered by PR-190
the congruence is the hypersurface normal n_mu=(-N(t),0,0,0)
the lapse has no spatial dependence in the adapted homogeneous chart
Theta=3H and H is strictly positive
the lower endpoint retains W2=1/25 rather than replacing it with another sector
exclusions: No rotating threading congruence is substituted for the hypersurface normal.
No Bianchi-V upper-endpoint dynamics are proved by this obstruction.
No native solver or native morphology atlas result is asserted.
No theorem capability is granted before PR-285.
singular_loci: Theta=0 or H=0 makes W2 normalization unavailable
a non-hypersurface-normal threading is outside this claim
a spatially varying lapse is outside the registered homogeneous coordinate fixture
boundary_or_initial_conditions: upper endpoint invariants (3/25,0,3/100,1/50) are not refuted by this specific Frobenius check

target.canonical_form: Exact rational zero normal-frame vorticity, W2=0, positive registered lower/interior W2 values 1/25 and 3/100, their nonzero contradiction residuals, and explicit nonpromotion from a refuted constraint level.
target.equivalence_relation: exact equality over the declared rational/algebraic coordinate reduction
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not read another axis script, derivation, or result before submitting.
Do not assume a rotating threading and call it the registered hypersurface normal.
Do not replace the lower W2 target by zero or move it into shear.
Do not call flux cancellation a vorticity construction.
Do not treat tool preflight as claim validation.
Do not convert a missing engine or license into an exception or pass.
